headline: Global Stocks Tumble and Bonds Rally as Heavy AI Capital Spending Spooks Investors
summary: Global equity markets slumped while government bond prices leaped as investors took refuge in safe havens, worried that surging capital expenditures by artificial intelligence giants will fail to generate sufficient returns.
why: Mega-cap technology companies have driven broader equity index gains; investor skepticism regarding their capital spending returns can spark broad market rotations.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Escalating infrastructure and hardware expenditures without near-term revenue clarity compress operating margins.
